scenes.headline: How a video model repaints a game while you play
scenes.sub: The engine runs the rules. A 5B model paints every frame.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Fresco! This game is drawn as plain boxes, and a video model repaints every frame.

scenes.text: The game engine keeps the state and draws a cheap low-poly frame; a causal video model only has to repaint it, four frames at a time.
scenes.say: The engine keeps the game state and draws a cheap low poly frame. The model only repaints it, four frames at a time.

steps.say: You press a key. The engine applies it to its physics. The keys never reach the model.
Each frame, the engine draws the world as flat boxes.
Four frames become one latent, which the model reads as control.
One denoising step later, the decoder makes four finished frames.
Right, the engine's proxy. Pink boxes for buildings, a blue box for the car.
Left, the generated frame, with the HUD drawn on afterwards.

scenes.title: What the GPU does per chunk
scenes.say: Per chunk, the card does four things.

items.say: Encode the four low poly frames.
Denoise a fresh latent in one step.
Decode four frames, and send them out.
Then a second pass writes clean history into the cache. That costs throughput, not latency.

left.title: Action world model
items: It must imagine where walls are
left.say: In an action world model, your keys go into the network, and it imagines the walls.

right.title: Matrix-Game 4.0
items: Collisions and score stay in code
right.say: Here the keys go into the engine, the rules stay in code, and the model only paints.

scenes.title: Three speeds, one pipeline
scenes.note: 83.4 fps is four frames in 48 ms
scenes.say: Eighty three point four frames a second is four frames in forty eight milliseconds. Sixty is the capture ceiling.

scenes.label: key press to screen, from three frames of filling plus 48 ms
scenes.say: Latency is mostly the chunk: three frames of waiting plus the model. The claimed hundred and twelve fits inside.

scenes.text: Put everything a rule can decide in the engine, and the network only has to paint.
scenes.say: Put everything a rule can decide in the engine, and the network only has to paint.

recap: One step, four frames per chunk
scenes.say: The engine owns the game. One step makes four frames. Latency is mostly the chunk.
